script_text: Stop! Libra, the stars are screaming at you right now. Venus, your air ruling planet, is squaring Saturn in your seventh House of Partnerships, a tense alignment that stirs old commitment fears. This cardinal air element wants harmony, but Saturn demands boundaries, so don't ignore the friction. This is a wake-up call, not a verdict. In love, with Venus square Saturn in your seventh House, your partner may test loyalty; avoid cold silences and speak your needs before resentment builds. Your charm may not be enough to soften Saturn. In career and money, Saturn's square to Venus in your tenth House is delaying a promotion or funding decision, so negotiate a compromise timeline instead of forcing an authority battle. Your finances need patient restructuring. Avoid over-apologizing to keep peace; an unexpected offer may arrive through a neutral third party. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
